verification_identity.browser: Built unpacked Chrome extension in primary profile; extension explicitly reloaded and source page refreshed before checks; DevTools closed.

cases.expected: Detected table choices change the extraction target to the selected index.
cases.actual: 3 tables detected. Selected and extracted indices 0, 1, and 2; each changed the Extract table label and yielded that index's contents. Index 0: 241 rows × 6 columns; index 1: 14 rows × 1 column; index 2: 2 rows × 1 column.
cases.evidence: Native accessibility observations of the Showcase Tables panel and result rows on the named Wikipedia URL.

cases.status: PASS (bounded to exercised pages and indices)
cases.expected: Selected table produces visible actual rows and columns; a source without tables reports an honest empty state.
cases.actual: Index 0 displayed 241 rows and six columns (% of world, Date, Location, Notes, Population, Source); visible records included World — 8,232,000,000 and India — 1,429,404,000. Indices 1 and 2 also returned their observed contents. On https://example.org/, panel said No tables on this page and disabled Extract table 1.
cases.evidence: Native accessibility observations on Wikipedia and example.org; no fixtures or fabricated network data.

cases.case: T42 — auto_table preview/save/reopen/replay, draft stability, route mismatch
cases.status: PASS (bounded to one saved recipe and manual route-mismatch run)
cases.expected: Saved recipe reopens and replays its previewed table index; draft changes do not change saved config; route mismatch is disclosed.
cases.actual: Previewed table 0, saved through UI, reopened in Patterns, and replayed 241 rows. Changed draft selection to table 1 without saving; exact row remained config {table_index:0}, route unchanged, status ok/count 241. On /wiki/United_States, UI warned page was outside saved route; manual Run warned rows should be reviewed and returned 51 current-page infobox rows (including Population 341,784,857). Read-only exact-row verification after this run still showed saved route/config and status ok/count 241.
cases.evidence: UI observations on actual public Wikipedia routes plus safe exact-row read of extend.wbx_pattern for ID e6c0a2d9-0786-4a8f-9c7e-d1feb0b8c500. The mismatch action was an explicit user-triggerable manual Run with warning; it was not a silent route match.
cases.limitations: No browser reload/reopen cycle, other pages, auth transition, or service-error path exercised.

evidence_limits.native: Results reflect only the stated built artifact, primary Chrome profile, and real public pages observed in this run.
evidence_limits.screenshots: None captured; observations recorded from native accessibility state.
evidence_limits.data_access: Only safe exact recipe fields were read; no credentials were read or reported.
